decisions.reason: After surviving the initial launch period, this multi-model formwork line appears to meet or at least stay near aspiration levels, and its strong fit with the core system business makes retention more likely than withdrawal.

As a related product line that can support broader formwork and automation packages, it is likely kept unless its sales have persistently fallen short of aspirations enough to justify reallocating resources.
Its dedicated presentation and close complementarity with the firm's established modular formwork offer suggest acceptable performance and strategic value, so management would usually continue it.

This remains the most vulnerable survivor because it is a narrower component with lower visible prominence, but its close relatedness to the core portfolio and the firm's continuing growth still favor keeping it for now.
